confidence_notes: I ran five web searches: one for the RBA rate and four for prices. Kenting-specific food and drink prices came from crowd-sourced aggregators (a Traveltables Kenting page last updated July 2023 and a Nomad Watch Kenting page), cross-checked against Taiwan and Kaohsiung price indexes. I used that data for beer, coffee and the two meal anchors, and adjusted it upward for 2026 inflation and tourist-resort pricing. The searches found no reliable Kenting price for cocktails or wine by the glass, so those two are estimated from the local beer price. I assumed a cocktail costs about 2.3 times a draft beer and a wine glass about 2 times. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Taiwan's southern resort areas, not from inspecting any booking pages or listings. Kenting lodging swings widely between weekdays and July weekends or holidays. I assumed a typical July mix, so accommodation is the least certain group.
comparable_city_reasoning: Kenting is a seaside resort town in Pingtung County, Taiwan. Its restaurant and bar prices are close to Kaohsiung and Hengchun, with a modest tourist premium. Its summer accommodation prices sit above those of Kaohsiung and other non-resort southern Taiwan cities.
